problems.heading: Good marketing starts with how your business actually gets work.
problems.intro: GT Marketing is a marketing company in Darwin. Many local businesses still rely on word of mouth, a website that does not explain the offer, or ads that never turn into a call. The useful work is being found locally, saying clearly what you do, and following up.

items.title: Hard to be found
items.text: People search for a tradie, a cafe, a clinic or a local firm, and the business does not show up for Darwin, Palmerston or Casuarina.

items.title: A quiet website
items.text: The site is online, but it does not spell out the service, the area you cover, or the simplest way to get in touch.

items.title: Leads that go cold
items.text: Enquiries arrive by phone, form or message, and there is no simple way to reply, qualify them and book the work.

items.title: Scattered activity
items.text: Social posts, ads and a Google listing all exist, but they do not point at the same offer or the same next step.

system.heading: Start with the work you want. Then build the system that brings it in.
system.intro: We work with the owner, or whoever looks after marketing. The aim is a clear plan your team can run, not a pile of activity that only an agency understands.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: How you get work now, who you want more of, and what people in Darwin, Palmerston and Casuarina actually search for.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Agree the offer, the service area, the pages, the Google profile and the follow-up before anything is built.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Local SEO, the website and the path from enquiry to booking, written in plain language for the customers you want.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.text: You can see where enquiries come from and what to do with them. Ongoing help is there if you want it.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Look at what is bringing enquiries and what is not. Rankings and lead numbers are not guaranteed.
